geometrySource.authority: MTR Corporation Limited and Hong Kong Tramways, Limited (network, stations, service topology); OpenStreetMap (track geometry)
geometrySource.stationData: Official MTR journey planner and lines/stations open data; official Hong Kong Tramways tram stop list
geometrySource.method: One continuous centre-line per line, chained from its OSM route relation by exact shared nodes (branches join at the true junction, no breakpoints), then despiked, Chaikin-rounded and re-simplified for display; station positions are projected onto the refined line. The tramway is carried as its physical tracks — the two through directions plus the Happy Valley and 春秧街 branches — because its six numbered services all run over the same rails
